🏆 Merit Scholarship Program 2026

February 1, 2026
Finance Office
5 min read
🏆

New Merit Scholarship Opportunities

We are pleased to unveil the Merit Scholarship Program 2026, a comprehensive initiative designed to support deserving students in their educational journey. This program recognizes academic excellence, leadership qualities, and financial need.

Scholarship Categories

  • Academic Excellence: Full tuition coverage + monthly stipend
  • Sports Excellence: 75% tuition coverage
  • Leadership & Outreach: 50% tuition coverage
  • Financial Assistance: Partial tuition coverage based on need

Eligibility Criteria

Students must maintain a minimum CGPA of 3.5, demonstrate financial need, and show commitment to community service or extracurricular activities. International students are also eligible for select scholarships.

Application Process

The online application portal is now open. Students need to submit their academic records, financial statements, and an essay explaining how they plan to contribute to society. Applications will be reviewed by our scholarship committee, and selected candidates will be notified by March 31, 2026.

Benefits Beyond Tuition

Scholarship recipients also receive mentorship from senior faculty, networking opportunities with industry leaders, and priority access to internship and placement opportunities. This holistic approach ensures our scholars are prepared for successful careers.
